reason: Both George owners are named Hercules (C02 is a deceased estate), which clearly contradicts Johannes Lodewicus.
The only Uitenhage owner is Jan Hendrik Combrink, whose given names differ entirely from Frederik Johannes.

No owner is Jacobus Christoffel. C05 Jacobus Cornelis (Albany) has a conflicting second name, and C06 Jacobus sv Philip is a first-name-only match in Graaff-Reinet rather than Somerset, so neither is more likely than not.
Frederik Els in Somerset matches the first given name and the declared district; omitting the middle name Nicolaas is normal and nothing contradicts it.
The Beaufort owners are Samuel (a widow's claim), Jan Andries and Matthys Andries, and none fits Jacobus Frederik.
Exact match on all three given names, Johannes Gerhardus Stephanus, in the declared district of Beaufort.
The Johannes owners carry second names Arnoldus and Matthys, not Hendrik. A shared first name with different second names is only weak evidence.
No owner is named Adriaan: C01 is a widow, and C02 and C03 are sons of Barend with different names.
No owner is named Petrus Jacobus. C03 Casper Hendrik shares the father's name but is not this man.
Exact name match, Adolph Johannes, in Swellendam. The note 'sv Jan' is consistent with the genealogy father Adolph Johannes, plausibly known as Jan, a Dutch form of Johannes.
